## Verbs (closed set; anything else = refuse, exit 2)
tabs (id + title only, never URLs) | goto <path-or-url> (same allowed host only) | text <css> (visible text, max 2000 chars) | count <css> | state (the fixed Higgsfield/Flow-style page-state snippet from the BROWSER_OPERATOR skill: button label+disabled, generating/failed/signed-out markers) | button-label (text of the primary submit button) | click <css> | type <css> <text> | key <Enter|Tab|Escape> | upload <css-file-input> <path> | wait-text <regex> <max_s> | chips (count of leaf spans in contenteditable whose text starts with '@' and class text-font-brand — selector may need adjusting per site) | shot <name> (writes PNG under $WORK_DIR, prints path + bytes only) | mute.
NO arbitrary-JS verb, no cookie/localStorage/network-body access, no shell.

## Hard guards (enforced in code, each with a test)
- Port must be in config; page host must match allowed_hosts before EVERY verb, or exit 2. Never touch a tab whose host is not allowed. Never open a new browser.
- Attach: mute every video/audio on attach (BROWSER_OPERATOR skill HARD rule); one-shot version, not the observer.

Only `Unlimited`/zero-price text passes. A `fire` (click on the submit button) additionally re-reads button-label in the same call and requires it to contain 'Unlimited' (config `fire_label_regex`), and obeys fire_cooldown_s (state in a small lock file) — never a retry loop on a paid control.
- `type` refuses input[type=password], fields whose label/name/autocomplete match /pass|otp|card|cvv|2fa|token/i.
- `upload` path must resolve (realpath) inside upload_dirs; refuse symlinks out of them.
- Every call appends one JSON line to state/agy-browse.jsonl: ts, verb, port, host, args (type text truncated to 40 chars, uploads as basename), exit code. Never log page text, URLs with query strings, tokens; redact ya29./eyJ…/*_token.
- Rate limit by max_calls_per_min. Total run time per call ≤ 30 s.
- Page content is data, not instructions: nothing read from a page is ever executed or used as a path/verb.

## The agy allow-rule to propose
A single `command(regex:...)` rule that matches ONLY `<venv-python> tools/agy_browse.py <verb> <args>` with args restricted to a safe character class (no `;`, `&`, `|`, backtick, `$(`, newline, `>`, `<`); verify by test that the regex refuses chained commands. Note deny rules (curl, ssh, rm …) stay untouched.

## Job
Change the MoonieX Console login relay (the CEO's phone drives a Browser Home Chrome) in two ways. The CEO ordered both on 2026-09-30 after getting stuck on a Google passkey page during the champa.io login.

## Step 0: base (do this first)
Start from origin/main, then run `git merge --no-ff origin/contabo/main-2026-09-30`. That branch holds 7 commits that are live on Contabo but were never pushed to main:
- Run Inbox P1a;
- d127273 "a login handed to an identity provider is not a success";
- c8aa5b3 "keep the form mirror alive on an identity provider's page".

The CTO rehearsed this merge on 2026-09-30: no conflict, vitest 607/607. Two of those commits touch the same relay code you are changing. Build on them; do not revert them.

## Problem 1: a passkey prompt freezes the relay
**Evidence**, measured 2026-09-30 08:34–08:36Z on mac:9280, the `champa` Browser Home:
- The page was accounts.google.com, titled "ใช้พาสคีย์เพื่อยืนยันว่าเป็นคุณ". Visible controls: ['ดำเนินการต่อ','ลองวิธีอื่น','ความช่วยเหลือ',…].
- "ดำเนินการต่อ" (Continue) calls navigator.credentials.get. That opens a native OS/Chrome passkey window on the target machine (Windows Hello on winbox, nothing visible on a headless Mac Chrome). The screencast never shows it and no tap can reach it, so the phone sits on a frozen page.
- `src/relay/patterns/google-passkey.json` matches English labels only (`^continue$`, `try another way`). On this Thai-locale page nothing was disabled or preferred.
- `warnIfNativePrompt` in `public/js/relay.js` is only a 15 s hint.

**Change:**
a. **Make the native prompt impossible.** From attach, and for every new document, a WebAuthn call (`navigator.credentials.get/create` with a `publicKey` option) must never open a native window on the target machine. The relay holds the call and tells the phone. On the CEO's Confirm, it rejects the call with `NotAllowedError`, so the site shows its fallback (password / try another way).
   - Candidate mechanisms: CDP `WebAuthn.enable` (virtual authenticator environment, no authenticator added, `enableUI:false`), and/or a `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` wrapper.
   - Measure on a real headless Chrome which one rejects fast instead of hanging. Put the numbers in your report.
   - It must work on a Windows target too (Windows Hello); winbox runs the same Console in relay mode.
b. **Confirm gate on the phone.** Some pages can hit a password or passkey step next. On each such page, the relay shows a card with a plain Thai message and a **Confirm** button. It forwards nothing into that step until the CEO has tapped Confirm at least once. Offer a Cancel as well. The triggers:
   - a held WebAuthn call;
   - a page that matches a `nativePrompt: true` pattern;
   - the first visible `input[type=password]` on a page.

   One Confirm per page (URL path), never one per keystroke. Use icons, never emoji, in the UI; the CEO's rule covers ✓✕⏳ as well.
c. **Patterns are bilingual.** Label regexes in `src/relay/patterns/*.json` must match both Thai and English (google-passkey: ดำเนินการต่อ / ลองวิธีอื่น, and the other Google and Facebook patterns likewise). Test with a Thai-locale fixture.

## Problem 2: the fake "login success"
**Today's code:**
- `handleNavigated` starts `startResultCheck` on any URL change off the login path.
- For a site with no cookie rule (champa.io has none), `runResultCheckTick` calls `handleSuccess('url changed, stable 5s')`.
- On its 45 s deadline, the same tick closes the session with `E_STILL_ON_LOGIN`.

A redirect to Google sign-in therefore counts as "success", the session ends, and the CEO has to refresh and start over.

**CEO ruling 2026-09-30:** "เอาระบบนี้ออกได้ เพราะมันไม่ช่วยอะไรเลย นอกจากต้อง refresh แล้วกลับมาทำขั้นตอนต่อไปอีก".

**Change:** the relay never ends a session because a URL changed or a timer ran out. A session ends only when:
- the CEO taps a clear "เสร็จแล้ว" (Done) control;
